theme_strategy: Hybrid Context: The platform must switch seamlessly between a 'Mission Control' (Dark Mode optimized for 24/7 authority dashboards with low eye strain) and a 'Field Operations' (High-Contrast Light Mode optimized for outdoor daylight visibility on mobile). It must feel serious, data-driven, and utilitarian—mimicking true military or government tactical systems.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter or Roboto. Cabinet Grotesk for section titles provides an authoritative, structured voice. IBM Plex Sans ensures absolute legibility for dense paragraphs.
rules.metrics: All data points, coordinates, timestamps, and severity labels MUST use JetBrains Mono (e.g., `font-mono`).

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with The Performance Pro (Tactical).
colors.contrast_rules: Avoid gradients. Use solid fills or 10% opacity tints of the severity colors for backgrounds of warning panels. Ensure text over severity colors meets APCA contrast guidelines (use white text on Critical/High, black/dark on Low/Medium if needed).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Dashboards should use 1px solid borders to delineate panels, resembling a strict grid or command-center console rather than floating 'SaaS' cards. Shadow is removed in favor of structural borders.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp. Use `rounded-none` or absolute maximum `rounded-sm` (2px). No pill-shaped cards in the authority dashboard.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle topographical line SVGs at 5% opacity can be used in empty states or login screens to reinforce the GIS/mapping nature of the application.

authority_dashboard.strategy: Map-First 'Bento' High-Density Grid. The map is the dominant element.
authority_dashboard.sidebar_span: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 xl:col-span-3 h-full border-l overflow-y-auto bg-surface
authority_dashboard.overlays: Map overlays (Legend, Time/Date, Quick Filters) must float over the map using absolute positioning with deep blur (`backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80`) and sharp borders.

mobile_field_citizen.strategy: Mobile-First Utility. Large touch targets (min h-12), high contrast, low-bandwidth design. Forms for GPS/Photo upload must be sequential and clear.
mobile_field_citizen.spacing: Use comfortable padding (`p-4`, `p-6`) to prevent misclicks outdoors.

component_guidelines.priority_badges: Labels like P1 (IMMEDIATE) must be styled structurally. E.g., `border border-red-600 text-red-600 bg-red-600/10 font-mono text-xs px-2 py-1`.
component_guidelines.map_legend: Permanent overlay component. Must explicitly define the color language (Green/Amber/Orange/Red) with crisp typography.
component_guidelines.buttons: Tactical/Brutalist. Flat, sharp edges, distinct hover states via color inversion (`hover:bg-primary hover:text-white`).
component_guidelines.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI forms. Inputs should have 1px borders, solid backgrounds, and clear focus states (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-500 rounded-none`).

motion.philosophy: Utilitarian & Snappy. Avoid bouncy or slow animations.
motion.transitions: Use fast fade-ins for panels (`duration-150 ease-out`).
motion.alerts: Incoming Critical Alerts can use a subtle pulsing border (`animate-pulse`) on the P1 badge or map marker.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional dashboards. Use 'duotone' or 'regular' weight for clear legibility.
media.map_integration: react-leaflet. Ensure map tiles match the theme (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter for dark mode, CartoDB Positron for light mode, or satellite tiles when requested).

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, input, tab, and severity label must have a descriptive kebab-case `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='filter-severity-critical'`).
accessibility.color_blindness: Do not rely on color alone. Always pair the severity color with the text label (e.g., '[!] CRITICAL' or an icon).

universal_guidelines: Prioritize data density and signal-to-noise ratio over negative space in the Authority Dashboard.
Never use generic AI chatbot or cutesy SaaS illustrations.
Do not use transition-all. Target explicit properties (transition-colors, transition-opacity).
Ensure the layout does not break when long region names or multi-line alert texts are injected.
Use sonner for non-intrusive toast notifications.
Avoid transparent dropdown backgrounds. Always use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds with clear borders.

hero_login.description: Dramatic mountain landscape suitable for the background of the login/auth screen (apply heavy dark/blue tint overlay for readability).

landslide_report_placeholder.description: Mudslide blocking a rural road. Use as a placeholder for a citizen or field officer uploaded report photo.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
Install react-leaflet and leaflet for the GIS map implementation.
Implement a role-selection login screen first, which routes to distinct layouts: Authority (dense dashboard), Field Officer (mobile UI), Citizen (public map/report UI).
Ensure map overlays and sidebars overlap cleanly without visual clipping or transparent collisions.
